answer: Because the dune reference is updated at each nadir checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the vertex audit records how much each answer added. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 4 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 110 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
